meta.author: OpenMedia
meta.summary: Quora: hide the sign-up wall and restore scrolling and unblur, from community filter lists. Site not reachable for live checks.
meta.notes:
**Not verified live.** quora.com blocked or errored for the research browser (403 for plain requests, an error shell for headless Chrome), so every selector here is SOURCE. Fixtures real.html and desktop-real.html are hand-written, not captures.

SOURCE: r/uBlockOrigin "Filter that bypasses Quora's page lockup + login popup" (www.quora.com##.qu-zIndex--blocking_wall and www.quora.com##.qu-overflow--hidden:style(overflow: auto !important)), a public gist "Stops blur overlay on Quora" (##[class*="blocking_wall"], `.qu-overflow--hidden` overflow), and an r/uBlockOrigin answer suggesting [class*="signup_wall_wrapper"]; the uBlock Annoyances list carries similar rules. These are Quora's readable atomic class names (qu-*), but the partial matches depend on the wall keeping the names blocking_wall and signup_wall_wrapper, which may have changed since those posts (2020-2022).

The 1.0.0 cookie, ad and app rules are generic and untested here. NOT done: no thumbnail or comment options, since no real markup could be viewed; no phone check.
